The project's Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 4 copies f4952.line4e, which forms/2025/f4952.yaml figures (the smaller of line 4d and the net capital gain) whether or not a Form 4952 is filed; on these returns there is no investment interest (f4952.line1 is zero), so no Form 4952 exists and OpenTaxSolver's line 4 is zero (sched_D_tax_worksheet: `ws[4] = 0.0; /* Form 4952, line 4e. Usually 0.0. */`). The worksheet reads "Enter the amount from Form 4952, line 4e", and an unfiled form has no amount, so the engine's reading follows the text and the project's is a candidate defect; line 3 is zero on the same returns, so lines 5 (line 3 less line 4, not below zero) and 8 (the smaller of lines 3 and 4) are zero either way and the tax is unmoved.
cite: i1040sd, Schedule D Tax Worksheet, line 4: "Enter the amount from Form 4952, line 4e*"; footnote: "If applicable, enter instead the smaller amount you entered on the dotted line next to line 4e of Form 4952."

cause: Form 8995 line 11 on a return whose deductions exceed adjusted gross income: the project floors qbi.taxable_before at zero (subtract_floor0), OpenTaxSolver prints the signed difference (taxsolve_f8995: `L[11] = f1040i.L11a - f1040i.L12 - f1040i.L13b`). The instructions define the line as an arithmetic difference with no floor, so the engine's reading follows the text and the project's sign is a candidate defect; line 13 (line 11 less line 12, not below zero) is zero on both sides, so the deduction is unmoved.
cite: i8995, Line 11: "Enter your taxable income figured before any QBI deduction, computed as follows. Form 1040 or 1040-SR filers: Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11a, minus lines 12e and 13b."
